purpose: Isolated one-page experiment to measure incremental retrieval coverage for GPU communication, inference economics and agentic infrastructure, and physical-AI runtime terms. No production query changes.

groups.name: GPU communication and interconnect
groups.query: cat:cs.DC AND (all:"GPU-initiated communication" OR all:"GPU communication" OR all:"GPU networking" OR all:NCCL OR all:NVSHMEM OR all:RDMA OR all:"all-to-all")

groups.name: LLM inference energy and KV cache
groups.query: (cat:cs.LG OR cat:cs.AI) AND (all:"LLM inference" OR all:"inference energy" OR all:"energy cost" OR all:"KV-cache" OR all:"agentic serving" OR all:"inference power")

groups.name: Agentic GPU capacity and short-lived jobs
groups.query: (cat:cs.DC OR cat:cs.AI OR cat:cs.LG) AND (all:"warm GPU capacity" OR all:"GPU job scheduling" OR all:"agentic workload" OR all:"reinforcement learning workload" OR all:"warm pool" OR all:"GPU capacity")

groups.name: Physical-AI runtime and world-action models
groups.query: (cat:cs.RO OR cat:cs.CV OR cat:cs.AI) AND (all:"world-action model" OR all:"robot policies" OR all:"runtime adaptation" OR all:"action-interface mismatch" OR all:"state-action-effect" OR all:"mobile robotic mission" OR all:"robot learning" OR all:"world model")
